title_sq: Vile per shitje te Liqeni i Farkes!
description_sq:
Vila ndodhet ne nje ng zonat me te kerkuara rezidenciale ne periferi te Tiranes, ne Liqenin e Farkes, nje zone kjo e njohur per qetesine, ajrin e paster dhe jetesen ne natyre.
Vila eshte pjese e nje kompleksi eksluziv me vetem 16 vila, te organizuar ne menyre te rregullt per te garantuar privatesi, siguri dhe nje standard te larte jetese. Kompleksi perbehet nga vila 2 dhe 3 kate, te projektuara me arkitekture moderne dhe funksionale. Vilat jane ndertuar me standarde te larta cilesie, duke perdorur materiale bashkekohore dhe termoizolim efikas.
Kjo vile eshte nje zgjedhje ideale per ata qe kerkojne balancen mes jeteses ne natyre dhe komoditetit te urban!
title_en: Villa for sale in Lake Farke!
description_en: The villa is located in one of the most sought-after residential areas on the outskirts of Tirana, in Lake Farka, an area known for its calmness, clean air and living in nature. The villa is part of an exclusive complex with only 16 villas, organized in an orderly manner to guarantee privacy, security and a high standard of living. The complex consists of 2 and 3 floor villas, designed with modern and functional architecture. The villas are built with high quality standards, using contemporary materials and efficient thermal insulation. This villa is an ideal choice for those looking for a balance between living in nature and urban comfort!
